hero.subtitle: Crafted with immaculate alcohol for a cleaner, more refined fragrance experience — a modern Arabian luxury, distilled.

about.p1_a: Bikr was born from a single conviction: a fragrance is only as honest as the spirit that carries it. Where the industry hides behind synthetic carriers, we begin with
about.p2: Every composition is built on rare oils, Damascena roses, and oud aged in cedar — then given the space to breathe. The result is a fragrance that wears closer, lasts longer, and never betrays its source.

items.alcohol_d: Crystal-clean spirit that carries scent without interference.
items.lasting_d: 24+ hours of refined sillage with a velvet drydown.
items.premium_d: Damascena rose, Cambodian oud, aged sandalwood.
items.packaging_d: Hand-finished bottles wrapped in gilded calligraphy.
items.luxury_d: From unboxing to wear — a private salon ritual.

featured.intro: Four compositions, each built around a single rare material and a single emotional truth.

testimonials.quote: I've never worn a fragrance that lingered with such honesty. Noir Oud is now part of who I am.
testimonials.name: Layla A.

testimonials.quote: The clarity of the alcohol is immediately obvious. There is no harshness — only the perfume itself.
testimonials.name: Marcus D.

testimonials.quote: Bikr's Rose Impérial is the most refined rose I have ever owned. Worth every pound.
testimonials.name: Sara K.

footer.tagline: A modern Arabian maison crafting fragrances on immaculate alcohol — pure, lasting, and unmistakably yours.
